title: TSMC says advanced semiconductor capacity remains in short supply amid booming AI demand
html: Amid growing market concerns over artificial intelligence (AI), Taiwan's premier of the Executive Yuan Jung-tai Cho invited representatives from the financial and industrial sectors to a meeting on November 23 to bolster confidence in Taiwan's economic...
summary: TSMC said semiconductors continue to play an indispensable and central role in the broader AI trend, noting that demand for advanced process technologies remains strong and capacity will remain tight.
